questions.answer: Very difficult and unsure of whether you would get a course or not.

questions.answer: Not much actually.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was pretty difficult, you need to study more than one would expect.

questions.answer: I was difficult, as grades were calculation from achivements, quizzes and assignment from the entire course, not just the final exam, as in Denmark.

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Easy enough, Canada culture isn't that far from danish culture.

questions.answer: Attend events.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Nothing special. They didn't really have their "own" culture as much.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Be early on course registration.
Be ready for sudden burst of expenses.
Have fun.
